en.hubeali: ‘(A matter) was raised to Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> of a man who squeezed the stomach of a man until he defecated in his clothes. So he<sup>asws</sup> judged upon him that he (also) be squeezed in the stomach until he defecate in his clothes, just as he (the other one) had defecated, or he is fined one-third of the wergild’.
